primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'C_{active}': 'dimensionless, active usable data count', 'C_{seeded}': 'dimensionless, total seeded source universe'}

reasoning_traces.think:
The core duality lies in balancing data breadth (coverage) with depth (trust), where insufficient coverage creates a gap that undermines even high-trust data. The failure mode occurs when trust indices are computed without considering coverage constraints, leading to overconfidence in sparse datasets. The system must enforce a minimum coverage threshold before assigning trust scores. Freshness acts as a dynamic constraint on trust, ensuring temporal relevance. The kernel of the model is a multi-dimensional trust lattice, where each dimension—coverage, trust, freshness—is a component of a unified confidence measure. This lattice enables both GSI’s probabilistic inference and GSE’s adaptive decision-making.
